title: Trade-Up Cancellation Fee — Kessler Care Retail Plans
content:
**Fee clause.** The retail cancellation fee on a cancelled Kessler Care Prepaid Maintenance Plans Essentials, Plus or Premium plan follows the customer's latest vehicle purchase with the group. It reads the vehicle price charges posted on the customer's Kessler vehicle purchase deals in the Vehicle Purchase Agreements records, net of vehicle price charges reversed. Within each window, the count is the charges posted with a date in that window less the charges reversed with a date in that window. Windows are measured back from the effective date, which is the request date.

| Net vehicle price charges | Retail cancellation fee (USD) |
|---|---|
| One or more posted fewer than 1 whole month before the effective date | 0.00 (waived) |
| Otherwise, one or more posted fewer than 3 whole months before | 35.00 |
| Otherwise | The plan's cancellation fee |

**Cases (hypothetical, effective date 9 March).**
| Vehicle price charge | Fee |
|---|---|
| Posted 1 March | 0.00 |
| Posted 9 February (1 whole month back) | 35.00 |
| Posted 10 December (2 whole months back) | 35.00 |
| Posted 9 December (3 whole months back) | the plan's cancellation fee |
| Posted 1 March, reversed 4 March | the plan's cancellation fee |
